items.title: Bank of England risks prolonged high interest rates, warns Niesr
items.summary: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research warns that the Bank of England's recent hesitant rate rise risks keeping inflation above target until at least 2030.

items.title: London market insurers face core technology overhaul as AI adoption grows
items.summary: Research by Federato shows that more than three-quarters of London market insurance organisations anticipate substantial changes to core technology to meet underwriting demands.

items.title: Marsh, HIVE Underwriters, Bspoke Commercial and Gallagher announce senior appointments
items.summary: Insurance Business UK reports on recent industry leadership changes spanning aviation broking, capacity management, digital trading and financial institutions.

items.title: Aviva fleet collision claims rise 19% from August to November
items.summary: Aviva commercial motor claims data reveals a consistent seasonal rise in collision claims between August and November, prompting calls for winter fleet preparation.

items.title: London brokers embrace AI but fear succession gap, survey finds
items.summary: Research from Burns & Wilcox Global Solutions shows 96% of London brokers view AI positively, even as 92% express concern over replacing retiring Baby Boomers.

items.title: Irwell passes £50 million GWP after 30% growth, opens London office
items.summary: Liability and legal expenses insurer Irwell has grown gross written premium by 30% year on year to pass £50 million, supported by coverholder partnerships and new product lines.
